desc: These metal restraints can bind a Small or Medium creature. Escaping the manacles requires a successful [[/check activity=dnd5eactivity000]] check. Breaking them requires a successful [[/check activity=9DosjAvEYAW0LLK8]] check. Each set of manacles comes with one key. Without the key, a creature proficient with thieves' tools can pick the manacles' lock with a successful [[/check activity=9IBcoj8ChH1OiDT8]]{DC 15 Dexterity} check. Manacles have 15 hit points.
name: manacles
